chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rabi' ibn Abdullah, from al-Fadl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

My father was brought the 'Khumra' on the day of al-Fitr, so he ordered it to be returned, then he said: 'This is a day on which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to love to look at the horizons of the sky and to place his face upon the ground.'

key_terms.آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ: The horizons of the sky, indicating looking around at the creation.
key_terms.الْخُمْرَةِ: A type of cloak or garment, often referring to the Prophet's cloak.
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, referring to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ: The day of Eid al-Fitr, the festival marking the end of Ramadan.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet do on the day of Eid al-Fitr according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates that on Eid al-Fitr, he presented a 'Khumra' (a fine cloak or garment) to his father, who ordered it returned, highlighting the virtue of simplicity and avoiding ostentation on this festive day. The Imam then explained that this day is one where the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) would look at the horizons of the sky and prostrate, indicating a time for gratitude and reflection.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al-Fazl Bin ShAzaan, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Rabi’e Bin Abdullah, form Al-Fazl Bin Yasaar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said:

‘Iasws came over to myasws father with the ‘Khumra’ on the day of (Eid) Al-Fitr, but heasws instructed with returning it, then said: ‘This is a day which Rasool-Allahsaww used to love that hesaww looks at the horizons of the sky, and hesaww placed hissaww face upon the ground’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Rib‘i ibn ‘Abd Allah from al-Fadl ibn Yasar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

On the day of al-Fitr al-Khumrah (mat) was brought for my father but he commanded to return it and then said, “This is a day on which the Messenger of Allah loved to look at the horizons of the sky and place his face on earth.’””
